paragraphs.text: Skill panel for DeepSeek Harness: lists local skills in the official right sidebar with Chinese name
s and categories; click to insert /skill-name into the composer.
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lists your local skills in the **official right sidebar**, with Chine
se names, categories, and a summary for each. Click a skill to copy `/skill-name` to the clipboard.
- **Right sidebar tab** -- registers into DSH's official right Sidebar (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-

sidebar-right`) via the two-stage tab API. No third-party sidebar dependency.
- **Reads local skills

** -- scans `~/.agents/skills` and `~/.dsh/skills`, reading each skill's `meta.yaml`.
- **Chinese na
mes** -- `display-name-zh` / `summary-cn` / `tag` from `meta.yaml`; falls back to the directory name

.
- **Search and filter** -- a text box plus category chips.
- **One-click copy** -- clicking a row
Then restart the desktop client. For the web profile use `--profile web`.
| `DSH_SKILL_DIRS` | Extra skill roots, separated by the OS path delimiter (`;` on Windows, `:` on P
OSIX). Scanned before the two defaults. |
